nodes.label: GM Binder PDF
nodes.rationale: Printable A4 PDF (WeasyPrint): cover, story beats with read-aloud boxes, every connection naming its target's chapter and page so the binder works on paper; places with painted maps; NPCs with portraits and stat blocks.

nodes.label: Campaign Menu
nodes.rationale: Dropdown from the campaign name: lists open/all campaigns in PENNODEPAPER/CAMPAIGNS, plus New campaign, Branch this campaign, Open a campaign folder, GM binder (PDF), Backups & sync.

nodes.label: Canvas Detail View
nodes.rationale: Full cards with summary, tags, status badges (done/active), thumbnails and a 'players are here' marker; typed coloured edges with labels.

nodes.label: Canvas Overview View
nodes.rationale: Zoomed-out level of detail: cards collapse to colour and title so the whole story is visible at a glance; minimap bottom right.

nodes.label: AI Chat Panel
nodes.rationale: Claude/agy backend switch, MCP tool-call cards (get_node, get_graph, view_file, batch, lint_story), threads per node, and a context node chip for @-mentions.

nodes.label: Card Enlarge In Place
nodes.rationale: Double-click grows a card in place with picture, read-aloud and notes while the camera zooms; Esc / empty-canvas double-click restores camera.

nodes.label: Inspector Images Section
nodes.rationale: Cover image, size preset (Scene 1344x768), saved prompt, Generate and 'AI writes it'; campaign style appended automatically; show-to-players via VTT (handout / map screen) or export file.

nodes.label: Battle Map Editor
nodes.rationale: Grid plan (22x14, 6ft/cell) shared by user and AI: Room, Paint, Erase, Door, Wall, Prop, Label, Token tools; Plan/Model Input/Painted views; painted versions history.

nodes.label: One-Pass Map Painting
nodes.rationale: Single-pass painting lets tables drift, turn and merge; props do not land where the plan put them.

nodes.label: Terrain -> Props -> Blend Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Painting in steps (empty terrain first, then each prop group inpainted in place, then a blend pass) keeps every table, chair and barrel where the plan put it, with soft shadows.

nodes.label: One-Pass Region Painting
nodes.rationale: Rejected baseline: the city turns into a sunburst of blocks and rivers/roads wander off the drawn lines.

nodes.label: Fidelity / Creativity Setting (Faithful, Balanced, Painterly)
nodes.rationale: Lets the GM trade adherence to the drawn plan against painterly freedom of the ComfyUI render.

nodes.label: Stepwise Region Painting (terrain, rivers, roads, structures, blend)
nodes.norm_label: stepwise region painting (terrain, rivers, roads, structures, blend)
nodes.rationale: Painting land first, then rivers and roads along drawn lines, then each structure inside its area, then a blend pass keeps the result faithful to the plan.

nodes.label: Getting Back on Track (next steps, bypassed, roads not taken)
